name: Soratarou
source:
The protagonist. Having lost the person he loves most, he wastes away his colourless days in shock. Not knowing the meaning of life, nor knowing what he's meant to do.
[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/11/30/karudea/]official website[/url]]
